name: alonetzer-monorepo
description: Alon Netzer-Sereni newsletter - mobile app (Capacitor) + push notification server

scripts.build: npm run build -w app && npm run build -w server
scripts.test: npm run test -w server && npm run typecheck -w app
scripts.android:sync: npm run build -w app && npx -w app cap sync android
scripts.apk:debug: npm run android:sync && cd app/android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.apk:release: npm run android:sync && cd app/android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
